35839-an-examination-of-president-edward.title: Freedom Of The Will.
35839-an-examination-of-president-edward.creator: Unknown
35839-an-examination-of-president-edward.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I ENTERED upon an examination of the "Inquiry" of President Edwards, not with a view to find any fallacy therein, but simply with a desire to ascertain the truth for myself. If I have come to the conclusion, that the whole scheme of moral necessity which Edwards has laboured to establish, is founded in error and delusion; this has not been because I came to the examination of his work with any preconceived opinion.

arxiv-1910-00483.title: A Detailed Description of the CamSpec Likelihood Pipeline and a Reanalysis of the Planck High Frequency Maps
arxiv-1910-00483.creator: G. Efstathiou and S. Gratton
arxiv-1910-00483.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by G. Efstathiou and S. Gratton. This paper presents a detailed description of the CamSpec likelihood which has been used to analyse Planck temperature and polarization maps of the cosmic microwave background since the first Planck data release. The goal of the CamSpec pipeline has been to extract an accurate likelihood based on the TT, TE and EE spectra from Planck which can be used to test cosmological models.

arxiv-2211-03984.creator: Yuqin Yang, AmirEmad Ghassami, Mohamed Nafea, Negar Kiyavash, Kun Zhang, Ilya Shpitser
arxiv-2211-03984.description: Abstract We focus on causal discovery in the presence of measurement error in linear systems where the mixing matrix, i.e., the matrix indicating the independent exogenous noise terms pertaining to the observed variables, is identified up to permutation and scaling of the columns.

arxiv-2312-14696.title: On short Edgeworth expansions for weighted sums of random vectors
arxiv-2312-14696.creator: S. A. Ayvazyan
arxiv-2312-14696.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by S. A. Ayvazyan. The "typical" asymptotic behavior of the weighted sums of independent, identically distibuted random vectors in k k -dimensional space is considered. It is shown that under finitnes of fifth absolute moment of an individual term the rate of convergence by Edgeworth correction in the multivariate central limit theorem is of order O ⁡ ( 1 / n 3 / 2 ) O(1/n^{3/2}) . This extends the one-dimensional Bobkov(2020) result. Ключевые слова:

Edgeworth correction, standart Gaussian random vector, multivariate central limit theorem.

arxiv-2505-04909.title: Thermodynamic relation on black branes with arbitrary cosmological constant
arxiv-2505-04909.creator: Yubo Ma 1∗,2 , Songtao Zheng 1 , Yang Zhang 1,2 , Mengsen Ma 1,2 , Yunzhi Du 1∗,2
arxiv-2505-04909.description: Abstract We investigated the Goon-Penco (GP) relationship in ( n + 1 ) (n+1) -dimensional black branes with an arbitrary cosmological constant. Our analysis revealed that the GP relation preserved its form in four-dimensional and ( n + 1 ) (n+1) -dimensional spacetimes, demonstrating its universal behavior with respect to dimensionality.

arxiv-2506-06221.title: BiAssemble: Learning Collaborative Affordance for Bimanual Geometric Assembly
arxiv-2506-06221.creator: Yan Shen, Ruihai Wu, Yubin Ke, Xinyuan Song, Zeyi Li, Xiaoqi Li, Hongwei Fan, Haoran Lu, Hao Dong
arxiv-2506-06221.description: Abstract Shape assembly, the process of combining parts into a complete whole, is a crucial robotic skill with broad real-world applications. Among various assembly tasks, geometric assembly—where broken parts are reassembled into their original form ( e.g. , reconstructing a shattered bowl)—is particularly challenging.

arxiv-2507-00950.description: Abstract . Social media platforms serve as central hubs for content dissemination, opinion expression, and public engagement across diverse modalities. Accurately predicting the popularity of social media videos enables valuable applications in content recommendation, trend detection, and audience engagement. In this paper, we present Multimodal Video Predictor (MVP), our winning solution to the Video Track of the SMP Challenge 2025.

pmc-10660721.title: A Single, Multimodal Exercise Tolerance Test Can Assess Combat Readiness in Army-ROTC Cadets: A Brief Report
pmc-10660721.creator: Derek A. Crawford, Katie M. Heinrich, Christopher K. Haddock, W. S. Carlos Poston, R. Sue Day, Christopher Kaipust, Blake Skola, Amanda J. Wakeman, Eric Kunkel, Addison Bell, Emily Wilhite, Nathanial Young, Allison Whitley, Madelyn Fritts
pmc-10660721.description: The Army Combat Fitness Test (ACFT) is a multi-event assessment battery designed to determine the combat readiness of U.S. Army personnel. However, for Reserve Officers’ Training Corps (ROTC) programs the logistical demands of collegiate life make repeated administration of the ACFT challenging.

pmc-10811172.title: Antimicrobial peptide-modified AIE visual composite wound dressing for promoting rapid healing of infected wounds
pmc-10811172.creator: Yi Chen, Hongjin Qian, Dandan Peng, Yan Jiang, Qiaolin Liu, Yan Tan, Longbao Feng, Biao Cheng, Guilan Li
pmc-10811172.description: Wound infection is a major problem faced during wound healing. Therefore, it is necessary to develop wound dressings with excellent antimicrobial properties. Here, a smart response system of PVA-TPE/HA-AMP/SF/ALG wound dressing was prepared by a combination of chemical cross-linking and freeze-drying methods. We grafted AMP onto HA to endow the wound dressing with bacterial resistance and slow release of AMP.

pmc-11575998.title: Research progress of natural products targeting tumor-associated macrophages in antitumor immunity: A review
pmc-11575998.creator: Wang Chengzhi, Liu Yifan, Zhang Xiaoqing, Liu Peimin, Li Dongdong
pmc-11575998.description: As an important innate immune cell in the body, macrophages have a strong ability to phagocytic tumor cells and maintain the innate immune response. Tumor-associated macrophages play a more prominent role in regulating tumor immunity and are currently an important target of antitumor immunity.

pmc-11637409.title: Dose-response effects of multiple Ascaris suum exposures and their impact on lung protection during larval ascariasis
pmc-11637409.creator: Chiara Cássia Oliveira Amorim, Denise Silva Nogueira, Ana Clara Gazzinelli-Guimarães, Thais Leal-Silva, Fernando Sérgio Barbosa, Fabrício Marcus Silva Oliveira, Lucas Rocha Kraemer, Raquel Martins de Almeida, Jorge Lucas Nascimento Souza, Luisa Mourão Dias Magalhães, Remo Castro Russo, Marcelo Vidig
pmc-11637409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundHuman ascariasis is the most prevalent geohelminthiasis worldwide, affecting approximately 446 million individuals. In regions with endemic prevalence, the majority of infected adults are frequently exposed to the parasite and tend to have a low parasite load. Further studies are necessary to provide more evidence on the dynamics of infection and to elucidate the possible mechanisms involved in regulating protection, especially during the acute phase, also known as larval ascariasis.

pmc-11644308.title: Advancements in Agricultural Ground Robots for Specialty Crops: An Overview of Innovations, Challenges, and Prospects
pmc-11644308.creator: Marcelo Rodrigues Barbosa Júnior, Regimar Garcia dos Santos, Lucas de Azevedo Sales, Luan Pereira de Oliveira, Nikos Tsoulias, Gianmarco Bortolotti, Luigi Manfrini
pmc-11644308.description: Robotic technologies are affording opportunities to revolutionize the production of specialty crops (fruits, vegetables, tree nuts, and horticulture). They offer the potential to automate tasks and save inputs such as labor, fertilizer, and pesticides. Specialty crops are well known for their high economic value and nutritional benefits, making their production particularly impactful.

pmc-11716865.title: Assessing attitudes and beliefs of dementia risk and prevention in middle‐aged adults
pmc-11716865.creator: Stephanie M. Simone, Marina Kaplan, Tania Giovanetti
pmc-11716865.description: BackgroundHealthy lifestyle behaviors (e.g., physical activity, cognitive activity) protect against cognitive decline and reduce dementia risk. Alzheimer’s disease (AD) neuropathology begins several years before the onset of clinical symptoms and disability; thus, midlife may be a critical time during which healthy lifestyle behaviors may be most effective.

pmc-12743019.title: Dynamics of Dibothriocephalus spp. infection in fish from the Shardara Reservoir (Republic of Kazakhstan) and fish decontamination by freezing method
pmc-12743019.creator: Yerbol Baltabay, Bolat Yessimov, Gani Issayev, Ilyas Ikramov, Abylaikhan Azimbay, Dana Seksenova
pmc-12743019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The study aimed to investigate the infestation of commercial fish species in the Shardara Dam with Dibothriocephalus spp. plerocercoids, the localization of plerocercoids within fish bodies, and the effect of freezing treatment on plerocercoid mobility. The study was conducted from 2021 to 2024 in the area of the Shardara Dam, located on the Syr Darya River in the Turkistan Region, Kazakhstan. A total of 993 fish specimens were examined for the presence of Dibothriocephalus spp.

pmc-12840815.title: Developmental and Stress-Mediated Transcriptional Shifts in Riboflavin Metabolism Pathway in Arabidopsis
pmc-12840815.creator: Dikran Tsitsekian, Panagiota Mylona, Efstratios Kamargiakis, Stamatis Rigas, Gerasimos Daras
pmc-12840815.description: Background: Flavin cofactors, flavin mononucleotide (FMN) and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), are indispensable for plant metabolism, supporting photosynthesis, photorespiration, mitochondrial electron transport, nitrogen assimilation, and cellular redox balance. Both cofactors derive from riboflavin (vitamin B2), which plants synthesize de novo, unlike animals, which rely on dietary intake.

pmc-12859909.title: Heat priming enhances cross-tolerance to subsequent drought stress in Haloxylon ammodendron seedlings via transcriptional reprogramming and metabolic adjustment
pmc-12859909.creator: Xu Wang, Yameng Wang, Meng Yuan, Hua Zhang, Bo Wang
pmc-12859909.description: BackgroundHaloxylon ammodendron, a keystone species for restoring desert ecosystems, has extremely low seedling survival rates under natural conditions due to surface high-temperature and secondary drought stress. This study investigated the effects of heat priming on the tolerance of H. ammodendron seedlings to subsequent drought stress and the underlying molecular mechanisms.

pmc-13690112.creator: Ashraf Moini, Sonia Eskandarion, Atiye Heidaridalfard, Siamand Mazhar, Rana Karimi
pmc-13690112.description: Objective:The global prevalence of smoking among women of reproductive age is significant, and the impact of tobacco on assisted reproductive technologies requires evaluation. This study aimed to determine the association between cigarette or hookah smoking with in vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes.
